title: Get early access to Bath & Body Works' Advent calendar
text:

 Saman Shafiq USA TODAY Nov. 3, 2026, 6:00 a.m. ET Hear this story Bath & Body Works is allowing fans to sign up early for its limited-edition Advent calendar .
 The retailer's “Feel the Wonder” holiday special is packed with holiday fragrances, body care and accessories, seven of which are exclusive to the calendar, Bath & Body Works told USA TODAY. The calendar costs $50 and has a reported value of more than $115.
 Signups for early access begin Nov. 4, ahead of the calendar’s Nov. 16 release in stores and online.
 “This year’s Advent calendar was inspired by the traditions and moments that make the holiday season memorable, from decorating the tree to gathering with family and friends,” Melissa Tauro, vice president of merchandising at Bath & Body Works, told USA TODAY.
 Tauro said the calendar was designed to mix familiar holiday favorites with products created specifically for the release.
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. What is inside the Bath & Body Works Advent calendar?
 Bath & Body Works has not revealed every product inside the “Feel the Wonder Advent Calendar,” but the retailer says it contains 12 "surprises" spanning home fragrance, body care and accessories.
 Seven of the products are exclusive to the calendar.
 “Customers can expect a curated holiday experience that combines some of Bath & Body Works’ most-loved seasonal fragrances with exclusive products designed to surprise and delight,” Tauro said.
 Bath & Body Works teased that the lineup includes seasonal favorites such as the Winter 3-Wick Candle, the Fresh Balsam Concentrated Room Spray and an exclusive Wallflowers Fragrance Plug. Other products, meanwhile, have been kept tightly under wraps.
 The calendar is valued at more than $115 but will sell for $50.
 How to get the Bath & Body Works Advent calendar
 Signups for “Feel the Wonder" open Nov. 4, at 6 a.m. ET through Drops , Bath & Body Works’ platform for exclusive releases and early-access opportunities.
 The calendar will be available beginning Nov. 16 in stores and online for a limited time, while supplies last.
